name: Goldenmax International Technology Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, Goldenmax International Technology Ltd. is a manufacturer and global supplier of essential materials, notably copper clad laminates (CCL), alongside other related products. Marketed under the "Jinan" brand, these versatile materials are integral to a wide array of electronic applications. Their uses span critical sectors like military and telecommunications equipment, computing, industrial instrumentation, and automotive circuits, as well as consumer electronics such as home appliances, computer peripherals, watches, clocks, and LED products.
